question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Fiddle while Rome burns

options.text: To ignore serious issues during a crisis

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To ignore serious issues during a crisis. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Fiddle while Rome burns"** means to act indifferently or engage in trivial activities during a time of crisis or serious issues. (मुश्किल समय में गंभीर मुद्दों को नजरअंदाज करना) • **Example: **The manager was busy planning a party while the company was losing money – a classic case of fiddling while Rome burns. • **"Ignore serious issues during a crisis"** refers to neglecting or avoiding addressing important matters while focusing on irrelevant or minor tasks. (संकट के समय गंभीर मुद्दों की अनदेखी करना) • **Example: **The government was accused of fiddling while Rome burns as they focused on less critical reforms during the economic crisis. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To enjoy music** (संगीत का आनंद लेना): This is incorrect as the idiom does not relate to enjoying music. • **Example:** She loves to enjoy music at every opportunity, but this has no connection to the idiom. • **Option 3: To plan secretly** (गुप्त रूप से योजना बनाना): This is incorrect as the idiom does not imply secrecy. • **Example: **The team planned secretly to surprise their boss on his birthday. • **Option 4: To celebrate success** (सफलता का जश्न मनाना): This is incorrect as the idiom does not refer to celebrating success. • **Example:** The students celebrated their success after the exams were over. 30:T995, The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Defend)**.
